signatures.description: Replay a BBRv2-style congestion controller over packet traces (JSONL rows: ts_us, acked_bytes, lost_bytes, delivered, app_limited, rtt_us, ecn_ce) and reconstruct per-round state: delivery rate through the 10-round min-filter window, startup versus drain detection including the pipe < 3/4 cwnd rule, bandwidth plateau exit after 3 rounds without 25% growth, and loss-triggered probe-down on the 0.7 beta factor. Output must match the reference per-round state hash bit-exactly except pacing gain, which may differ by at most 1e-9 relative. Also report the first round where a naive BBRv1 rate sampler (no app-limited detection, no ECN response) diverges from the reference cwnd by more than 5%, and emit the last three round-state pairs as divergence_evidence.
